summary:
Changing climate, water scarcity and soil degradation pose major threats to agricultural productivity around the world. Helping farmers make sense of Earth observation data from NASA’s Earth Observatory and use it to better understand their crops, soil and water needs could support more sustainable agriculture. ANCHOR (An Agricultural Decision-support platform integrating NASA and historical data to support sustainable crop rotation strategy in Agriculture) was an agricultural decision-support platform developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data.

ANCHOR sought to help farmers explore sustainable crop rotation strategies and make informed decisions about their farm’s long-term resilience by tying together crop rotation analysis with insights about crop growth, weather, soil and water conditions. Based on farmer-provided information about past and future crops, soil conditions (e.g., soil type, pH levels, soil moisture), and irrigation practices, as well as historical and NASA Earth data about the land and climate, ANCHOR aimed to empower farmers to compare different crop rotation scenarios, understand challenges like water stress and make decisions to promote long-term soil and water health.

ANCHOR was designed to go beyond providing recommendations by presenting its reasoning process, data sources, limitations and sources of uncertainty.
details: Our project ANCHOR focuses on combining NASA Earth observations data with farmer-provided information to provide insights that can help farmers make more assertive and sustainable decisions. ANCHOR is an AI assisted agriculture platform aimed at making agriculture more informed, efficient and sustainable. ANCHOR provides insights related to soil and water management, planning crop rotation, choosing the most suitable crop and planning various agricultural operations like planting, watering and harvesting based on soil type, pH, moisture, crop requirements, water availability, irrigation methods, climate conditions, environmental risks, data reliability and many other factors. ANCHOR provides these insights by calculating important calculations related to agriculture, using various environmental data and with the help of AI assisted explanations. ANCHOR helps the farmers to better manage water resources, maintain healthy soils, plan crops effectively and adapt to changing climate conditions. Our team leveraged React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Google AI Studio, NASA resources like NASA POWER, NASA EONET and NASA GIBS, mapping, weather and geospatial data services and GitHub. We tried our best to think out of the box and have come up with an innovative solution that blends AI, satellite data, agriculture principles, interactive mapping functionalities and crop rotation planning into a single platform. Our project doesn’t just provide environmental data, but also makes it actionable for the users.
